scope: current repaired tgrs_nested_nonpolar_v2 held-object predictions only
paired_primary_unit: 20 held objects; learned seeds averaged within object-direction first

mesh.fold_rule_proven: OOD_FOLDS is a literal hard-coded mapping; each object is held exactly once; train/test object overlap is zero.
mesh.fold_selection_rationale: unknown: no random seed, randomization call, semantic-family label, or descriptor-stratification rule is present in the generator.
mesh.near_duplicate_scope: Exact current STL byte duplicates are excluded. The available 14-D extent/centroid/area descriptor is only coarse evidence; without a registered surface-distance threshold or semantic family labels, absence of geometric near-duplicates and family leakage remains unknown.

stress.measurement_equation: y_p(f)=H_p(f) E_p(f) exp(j phi0) exp(-j 4 pi f DeltaR/c)+n_p(f)
stress.snr_definition: SNR=10log10(Ps/Pn), Ps=(1/(2N))*sum_{p,n}|signal_p[n]|^2, with independent proper complex AWGN whose expected per-complex-sample power is Pn; real and imaginary variances are Pn/2.
stress.range_definition: DeltaR is monostatic radial range-reference error; exp(-j 4 pi f DeltaR/c) is the two-way phase ramp.
stress.calibration_definition: Each draw uses a session-fixed, sample-independent smooth residual H_p(f), independently realized for theta/phi receive channels. Gain and phase ripples have zero fitted constant/linear component and the stated peak absolute bounds.
stress.session_definition: A calibration session is one H_p(f) keyed by condition, draw, and receive channel. It is sample-independent and reused across all objects, folds, Frequency/rect-IFFT arms, and seven checkpoint seeds. Theta and phi responses are independent sessions.
stress.rng_definition: stable_seed joins key parts with '|', takes SHA-256, interprets the first eight digest bytes as an unsigned little-endian 64-bit integer, and seeds NumPy default_rng (PCG64). There is no single global stress seed.
stress.calibration_function: r(u)=sin(2piu+a1)+0.55sin(4piu+a2)+0.25sin(6piu+a3); ai iid U(-pi,pi). The least-squares degree-1 affine component beta0+beta1*u is removed on 91 points, the residual is divided by max absolute value, and scaled to the stated peak gain/phase bound. H_p(f)=10^(g_p(f)/20) exp(j*pi*psi_p(f)/180).

shared_draw_audit.awgn_key: receiver-awgn | condition | realization | sample_id; excludes model tag, representation, fold, and checkpoint seed
shared_draw_audit.calibration_key: cal-{gain|phase} | condition | realization | receive channel; fixed across samples, folds, representations, and checkpoint seeds
